verdict.rationale: Glama's docs describe an official MCP gateway/hosting service through which agents connect to MCP servers, with per-tool access control, inspector testing, and a hosted catalog (glama-docs-1,4,5,6). This directly satisfies the story since Glama is a hosting/gateway platform, not an agent, so serving MCP is a core in-scope capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of an agent actually connecting through the gateway, and community feedback highlights friction in publishing/quality-score workflows (glama-comm-2,3) rather than the connection experience itself.
